A wire claim with key 3 = 0xf4 (false) is accepted as INTERLEAVED by Python; Rust decodes mode via p.uint() (slot.rs:580) and rejects non-uint major types as MalformedClaim. Exploitable with a valid signature: a malicious federation gateway signs the canonical payload (mode=0), flips the mode byte on the wire; verify_slot_claim re-encodes via encode_claim_canonical (int 0), digest matches, Python accepts, Rust rejects — the same divergence class jkuj/s61e closed for keys 1/2/4/6/7. Fix: 'if type(mode) is not int or mode not in (_MODE_INTERLEAVED, _MODE_CONTIGUOUS): raise ClaimError' (type() is int also excludes bool). Pin with a decode test: tamper key 3 to False/0.0 on the happy_path_n1 envelope (same pattern as test_oversized_sibling_fields_rejected_at_decode).","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-09-09T02:16:19.615181586Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-09-09T02:16:19.615181586Z","labels":["python","gateway"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-ft5w","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-s61e","type":"discovered-from","created_at":"2026-09-09T02:16:19.763319804Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
